title: Tier 3 ECEF tile pipeline — Phase 2 PR 2c remaining sub-PRs (2c.2, 2c.3, 2c.4)
scope: Phase 2 PR 2c.1 LANDED at PR #159 (commit 975f605, dual-MVP scaffolding + originBackend + sphere ECEF helpers + 24-cell latitude parity). Remaining: 3 sub-PRs sequentially. PR 2c.2 = polygon DSL ECEF VS rewrite + retire-quantized + delete runtime requantize + runtime wall-mesh ECEF lift. PR 2c.3 = SyntheticEarthSurfaceBackend + BackgroundRenderer deletion. PR 2c.4 = TILE_LAYOUT_VERSION 1→2 + per-backend eviction + closeout tracking issue. Each sub-PR is its own branch + PR.

stories.title: PR 2c.2 — Polygon DSL ECEF VS rewrite + retire-quantized + delete runtime requantize
acceptanceCriteria: Branch feature/ecef-tile-pipeline-phase2-pr2c2 created from feature/ecef-tile-pipeline-phase2-pr2c (PR 2c.1 head).

runtime/src/engine/shader-dsl/shaders/polygon.ts: DELETED vs_main_quantized and vs_main_quantized_extruded DSL entries. KEPT vs_main (the line VS entry; bound at renderer.ts:822, 858 against lineVertexBufferLayout — must NOT be deleted).

runtime/src/engine/shader-dsl/shaders/polygon.ts: ADDED vs_main_ecef DSL entry — reads pos_h(vec3) + pos_l(vec3) + feat_id(f32) + abs_lon(f32) + abs_lat(f32) attributes; VS body has `ecef_rtc = pos_h + pos_l; out.position = u.mvp_ecef * vec4(ecef_rtc, 1.0)`. No project_geom call in this entry.

runtime/src/engine/shader-dsl/shaders/polygon.ts: ADDED vs_main_ecef_extruded DSL entry — reads same flat-fill attributes + face_normal(vec3) + wall_height(f32) + is_top(f32). face_normal feeds existing dot(normal, LIGHT_POS) MapLibre lighting. is_top discriminates wall-bottom (0) vs wall-top/roof (1), preserving wall_blend + tTop semantics at polygon.ts:444, 474.

compiler/src/tiler/vector-tiler.ts: packECEFPolygonVertices EXTENDED — now also computes abs_lon, abs_lat per vertex and packs them into stride-9 floats `[ex_h, ey_h, ez_h, ex_l, ey_l, ez_l, fid, abs_lon, abs_lat]`. Mercator-inverse formula (mx → lon_rad → lon_deg) + Mercator-Y-to-lat for abs_lat at tile decode.

compiler/src/tiler/vector-tiler.ts: vertices field at lines 1411 + 1623 swapped from `packDSFUNPolygonVertices(...)` to `packECEFPolygonVertices(scratch.pv, tileEcefCenter)` where tileEcefCenter = tileEcefCenterFromMerc(tileMx, tileMy) imported from runtime/projection/ecef.ts (or inlined sphere-Mercator → ECEF). KEEP packDSFUNPolygonVertices exported — still used by pointVertices at :1420, :1632.

runtime/src/core/polygon-mesh.ts: ADDED generateWallMeshExtrudedECEF(polygons, heights, tileEcefCenter): { vertices: Float32Array, indices: Uint32Array } — runtime wall-mesh generator emitting stride-13 ECEF + face_normal + wall_height + is_top. Bottom-ring vertices at lonLatToECEFSphere(lon, lat, 0) - tileEcefCenter, top-ring at lonLatToECEFSphere(lon, lat, height) - tileEcefCenter. abs_lon/abs_lat per vertex via Mercator inverse. face_normal per face (wall: horizontal outward normal; roof: +Up).

runtime/src/core/polygon-mesh.ts: DELETED quantizePolygonVertices + quantizePolygonVerticesExtruded exports + QUANT_POLY_STRIDE_BYTES + QUANT_POLY_RANGE constants (polygon-quantized retired; point path unaffected). stories.title: PR 2c.3 — SyntheticEarthSurfaceBackend + BackgroundRenderer deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Branch feature/ecef-tile-pipeline-phase2-pr2c3 created from PR 2c.2 head.

runtime/src/data/sources/synthetic-earth-surface-backend.ts CREATED. Class implements TileSource. Single z=0 tile. meta.scheme='web-mercator-xyz', meta.layoutVersion=TILE_LAYOUT_VERSION (=1 here; bumps to 2 in PR 2c.4), meta.bounds=world bounds, meta.minZoom=0, meta.maxZoom=0. Vertices via generateEarthSurfaceFillMesh from runtime/projection/earth-surface-fill.ts at default 32×16 density, projected via lonLatToECEFSphere per vertex, packed via packECEFPolygonVertices with tileEcefCenter=[0,0,0]. abs_lon/abs_lat per vertex from source mesh lat/lon (no Mercator inverse needed).

SyntheticEarthSurfaceBackend auto-attached by XGISMap constructor when style declares a background { fill: ... } block. Inserted as synthetic xgis layer at sort-order 0 of the opaque pass (ahead of every real tile). layer_depth_offset = -0.0001 on this layer.
runtime/src/engine/render/background-renderer.ts DELETED (entire 301-LOC file).
runtime/src/engine/shader-dsl/shaders/background.ts DELETED (subsumed by polygon DSL via standard polygon fill path).

All call sites removed: host.backgroundRenderer field on render-loop PassHost type, the `if (host.backgroundRenderer)` block at opaque-pass.ts:140-150, BackgroundRenderer import + instantiation at map.ts:1525-1526, host.backgroundRenderer.setMvp/setCamCenter calls, bundle-stats aggregation at render-loop.ts:535-539, emitBgWgsl references.
Grep 'BackgroundRenderer|backgroundRenderer|emitBgWgsl' outside .omc/, docs/, tests/ returns zero hits. Build green.
Opaque-pass clearValue { r:0, g:0, b:0, a:1 } pure-black 'no world here' sentinel PRESERVED at opaque-pass.ts (iter-196 contract preserved).

Public API XGISMap.setBackgroundFill(rgba | null) PRESERVED — reroutes to the synthetic backend's xgis layer fill colour. Unit test: setBackgroundFill([0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 1]) → render → fragment colour at canvas-centre on empty-style Mercator demo equals (0.1, 0.2, 0.3) within tolerance.
Debug-overdraw mode (?debug=overdraw) renders synthetic bg as one accumulator increment per fragment via the standard fs_overdraw polygon path. Manual verify.

Mesh-density facet check: pixel-diff fixture at z=0 ortho pitch=80 lat=0 — synthetic earth-surface looks smooth, no polygonal facets visible at >2 px scale. If failure, escalate widthSegments/heightSegments from 32/16 to 64/32 via constructor arg (cheap; 561 → 2145 verts).
Net LOC delta in PR body: between -250 and -350 (delete 301 LOC bg-renderer + ~50 LOC call sites; add ~100 LOC synthetic backend).
Latitude-spanning pixel-diff harness: byte-identical on Mercator; ≤ 0.5% pixel-delta on non-Mercator. z=0 ortho/azi/stereo/globe bg-curve fixture green vs spec screenshot.

stories.title: PR 2c.4 — TILE_LAYOUT_VERSION 1→2 + per-backend eviction + closeout tracking issue
acceptanceCriteria: Branch feature/ecef-tile-pipeline-phase2-pr2c4 created from PR 2c.3 head.
runtime/src/data/tile-source.ts: TILE_LAYOUT_VERSION constant changed 1 → 2. JSDoc updated to note 'Phase 2c PR landed' transition.
All 4 existing TileSource backends + the SyntheticEarthSurfaceBackend populate meta.layoutVersion = TILE_LAYOUT_VERSION (= 2). Grep 'meta.layoutVersion =' returns 5 hits.
VirtualCatalogAdapter proxies meta.layoutVersion via the same lazy-getter pattern as meta.scheme (Phase 1b AC1b.4).

runtime/src/data/tile-catalog.ts attachBackend method reads backend.meta.layoutVersion AFTER mergeBackendMeta runs. If backend.meta.layoutVersion !== undefined && backend.meta.layoutVersion !== TILE_LAYOUT_VERSION: invoke evictTilesForBackend(backend), emit one-shot xlog.warn with text containing 'tile-layout-version mismatch' + source name + cached + running versions, leave the backend attached (re-fetch on next visible frame).
Undefined layoutVersion treated as TILE_LAYOUT_VERSION_BASE = 1; eviction fires if TILE_LAYOUT_VERSION > 1.

evictTilesForBackend(backend) private method added to TileCatalog. Iterates dataCache (runtime/data/tile-catalog.ts:65 Map<number, Map<string, TileData>>), checks `entry.originBackend === backend` predicate (using field added in PR 2c.1), drops matching entries. Reuses existing budget-eviction code path with backend-identity filter.

Unit test runtime/src/data/tile-catalog-layout-version-eviction.test.ts: (a) backend with mismatch → backend's tiles evicted; (b) undefined treated-as-base → evicts when current > 1; (c) version match → no eviction. All three scenarios assert via dataCache state.
Manual cache-mismatch UX test: pre-PR cache loaded into post-PR build, observe re-decode under ~200 ms, no console errors. Documented in PR body.

Closeout tracking issue opened: GitHub issue titled 'Phase 2 closeout: retire dual-MVP at PR 2d final sub-PR' referencing the CLOSEOUT MILESTONE in plan Follow-ups + PR 2c.4 URL. Issue URL recorded in PR 2c.4 body.
